title: 3 Day Trip From Delhi by Bus: 7 Easy Plans
summary: Plan a 3 day trip from Delhi by bus with seven destinations, day by day shapes, best months and booking tips for overnight routes.
body_markdown:
The smartest way to plan a 3 day trip from Delhi is to stop counting daytime hours and start counting nights. A bus that leaves on Friday evening and arrives on Saturday morning turns a two day weekend into three days on the ground. That one change widens the choice of destinations a lot.


## **How These Seven Plans Work**


This guide lists seven places for a 3 day trip from Delhi by bus, with a day by day shape for each, the best months to go and the route page to check. It also explains the overnight bus method and answers common planning questions.


The simplest starting point is the[Delhi bus booking page](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-bus-booking-online) , which lists departures to the destinations below. Journey times in this guide are approximate, so confirm them on each route page before you plan around them.


# **3 Day Trip From Delhi by Bus: Seven Places That Fit the Plan**


A 3 day trip works when travel eats as little of the middle as possible. Choose a destination within one overnight ride, and the bus does the hard part while you sleep.


## **The Overnight Bus Method for a 3 Day Trip**


Most three day trips from Delhi follow one pattern. You board on Friday night, arrive on Saturday morning, spend Saturday and Sunday on the ground, and take the Sunday night bus back. You reach Delhi on Monday morning, in time for a late start or a half day.


The method saves two hotel nights and gives two full days at the destination. It works best on routes of about 6 to 12 hours, where a sleeper or semi sleeper gives real rest. Shorter routes can use a daytime bus instead.


## **Quick Comparison of Places Near Delhi for 3 Days**


The table gives a fast view of each destination. Journey times are approximate, and the route pages carry the current figures.


**Destination** **Approx. bus time** **Best for** **Best months**


Jaipur About 6 hours Forts, markets, food October to March


Rishikesh 6 to 7 hours Ganga, yoga, rafting October to March


Mussoorie 7 to 8 hours Hill views, easy walks March to June, September to November


Nainital 7 to 8 hours Lake and hill town March to June, September to November


Shimla 8 to 9 hours Colonial hill station March to June, December to February


Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj 10 to 11 hours Mountains and cafes March to June, September to November


Manali 12 to 14 hours Snow, valleys, adventure March to June, December to February


## **Jaipur: Forts and Bazaars**


Jaipur is the easiest 3 day trip because the journey is short. The zingbus listing shows about 283 km and roughly 6 hours, with several departures through the day and night. That means you can choose between a night bus and an early morning bus.


- **Day 1:** Arrive, check in and start with Hawa Mahal and the City Palace area.
- **Day 2:** Visit Amber Fort early, then spend the afternoon at Johari Bazaar and Bapu Bazaar.
- **Day 3:** Explore Nahargarh Fort or Jantar Mantar, then take an evening bus back.


See the[Delhi to Jaipur bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-jaipur-bus-route) for current services. Prices are approximate and may vary based on season, demand, and availability.


## **Rishikesh: River and Riverside Cafes**


Rishikesh suits travellers who want a slow trip with a little adventure. The pace is easy, and it pairs well with a short stop in Haridwar.


- **Day 1:** Arrive, rest and walk across the Ram Jhula and Laxman Jhula area.
- **Day 2:** Try river rafting if it is in season, then attend the evening aarti.
- **Day 3:** Visit a yoga class or cafe in the morning, then head back.


Check the[Delhi to Rishikesh bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-rishikesh-bus-route) . Rafting runs outside the monsoon months, so confirm availability before you go.


## **Mussoorie: An Easy Hill Escape**


Mussoorie is a hill station with short distances and gentle walks. It suits families and first time hill travellers who do not want a long ride.


- **Day 1:** Arrive, then walk Mall Road and the viewpoints near the centre.
- **Day 2:** Visit Kempty Falls and Gun Hill, and add Lal Tibba for the view.
- **Day 3:** Take a slow morning, then head down to the bus.


See the[Delhi to Mussoorie bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-mussoorie-bus-route) for departures. Weekends are crowded, so book early.


## **Nainital: Lake and Hill Town**


Nainital is built around its lake, and the trip revolves around it. Boating, a walk on Mall Road and the viewpoints fill most of the weekend.


- **Day 1:** Arrive and take a lake walk, then a boat ride in the afternoon.
- **Day 2:** Visit the viewpoints and a nearby lake such as Bhimtal.
- **Day 3:** Spend the morning on Mall Road, then take the return bus.


The[Delhi to Nainital bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-nainital-bus-route) lists current services. The town is small and gets very busy on weekends.


## **Shimla: Colonial Hill Station**


Shimla works well for travellers who like old buildings and cool air. The central area is compact and walkable.


- **Day 1:** Arrive and walk the Ridge and Mall Road.
- **Day 2:** Visit the Jakhu Temple, then take a short trip toward Kufri.
- **Day 3:** Spend a slow morning in cafes, then catch the return bus.


See the[Delhi to Shimla bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-shimla-bus-route) . The route is hilly, so plan for the arrival time and keep a layer ready.


## **Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj: Mountains and Cafes**


This is a longer ride, so it suits travellers who value the mountain setting. The Dhauladhar range sits behind the town, and cafes fill the lanes.


- **Day 1:** Arrive, rest and walk around McLeod Ganj.
- **Day 2:** Visit the Tsuglagkhang complex and Bhagsu waterfall.
- **Day 3:** Try a short walk toward Triund if the weather is clear, then head back.


Check the[Delhi to Dharamshala bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-dharamshala-bus-route) . A full Triund trek is better with an extra day.


## **Manali: The Long Ride Worth Planning**


Manali is the longest of the seven, so a 3 day plan is tight. It only works well with an overnight bus each way, and the days on the ground should be light.


- **Day 1:** Arrive, rest and walk around Old Manali.
- **Day 2:** Visit Solang Valley and the Hadimba Temple.
- **Day 3:** Spend a short morning around the town and take the return bus.


See the[Delhi to Manali bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-manali-bus-route) . If you want more time on the ground, add a fourth day.


## **Best Time to Visit Places Near Delhi**


Season shapes each plan more than distance does. Use the table above as a guide, and keep these rules in mind.


- **Winter plains:** Jaipur and Rishikesh are most comfortable between October and March.
- **Hill stations:** March to June and September to November suit most hill towns.
- **Snow:** December to February is the usual window for Shimla and Manali.
- **Monsoon:** Hill roads can be disrupted from July to September, so check conditions first.


## **How to Reach From Delhi by Bus**


Booking a bus from Delhi is simple, and a few habits keep a short trip smooth. Boarding points are spread across the city and nearby areas.


- **Pick the closest point:** Many routes list several boarding points in Delhi, Noida and Gurgaon.
- **Book both legs:** Reserve the return at the same time, especially for Sunday night.
- **Reach early:** zingbus recommends arriving about 15 minutes before departure.
- **Track the bus:** Live GPS tracking is available on the app.
- **Keep ID ready:** Carry a valid photo ID and your ticket on travel day.


## **Choosing Your 3 Day Trip From Delhi**


The right trip comes from matching your energy to the distance. If you want a relaxed weekend, Jaipur or Rishikesh are easy. If you want a hill escape, choose Mussoorie, Nainital or Shimla. If you want snow or big views, Manali and Dharamshala are worth the long ride.


Pick one, check the route page for your dates, and book the bus both ways. A simple plan made a week early usually beats a long list made on the bus.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What is the best 3 day trip from Delhi by bus?**


For a first 3 day trip from Delhi by bus, Jaipur, Rishikesh and Mussoorie are the easiest choices because the journeys are short.


### **Which places near Delhi are good for 3 days?**


Good places near Delhi for 3 days include Jaipur, Rishikesh, Mussoorie, Nainital, Shimla, Dharamshala and Manali.


### **How does a 3 day trip from Delhi by bus work?**


A 3 day trip works by boarding an overnight bus on Friday, using Saturday and Sunday, and returning by night bus.


### **Which weekend trips from Delhi by bus are shortest?**


The shortest weekend trips from Delhi by bus are Jaipur and Rishikesh, which take roughly 6 to 7 hours each way.


### **Is Manali possible as a 3 day trip from Delhi?**


Manali is possible as a 3 day trip from Delhi, but the long ride means you should travel overnight both ways.


### **What is the best time to visit places near Delhi?**


The best time to visit places near Delhi is October to March for plains, and March to June for hills.


### **Can I see snow on a 3 day trip from Delhi?**


You can see snow on a 3 day trip from Delhi in winter, most reliably at Manali and Shimla between December and February.


### **How do I reach Jaipur from Delhi by bus?**


You can reach Jaipur from Delhi by bus in about 6 hours, with departures listed from early morning to late evening.


### **How far in advance should I book a bus from Delhi?**


For weekend departures from Delhi, book at least a week ahead, and earlier around holidays and long weekends.


### **Where do zingbus buses board in Delhi?**


zingbus buses board at points across Delhi, including Kashmere Gate and several metro stations, depending on the route you choose.


### **Is an overnight bus comfortable for a short trip?**


An overnight bus is comfortable for a short trip when you choose a sleeper or semi sleeper and carry a light layer.


### **What should I pack for a 3 day trip from Delhi?**


For a 3 day trip from Delhi, pack a small bag, a light jacket, a power bank and comfortable walking shoes.
